rule: An item is done only when its check passes. 'live' checks run audit/live.spec.ts against a real host with real data; 'static' checks run audit/static.mjs; 'api' checks call the real API. Nothing is marked done by hand.

items.title: /v1/auth/me reports API-key and operator principals
items.check: GET /v1/auth/me with Bearer workload key returns authenticated principal (kind api_key, tenant)

items.title: Operator can list and revoke keys for any tenant
items.check: POST /v1/billing/operator/keys then revoke it with only the operator token; key is rejected afterwards

items.title: Key/operator principal sees signed-in UI and Admin
items.check: /operator with key+operator token renders Administration tools, header shows no Sign in buttons

items.title: Geometric neighbors are not presented as answers
items.check: /explore?q=photosynthesis: no result row contains 'geodesic' or 'frechet'; no 'neighbors' facet

items.title: No-match is an empty state, not N errors
items.check: /explore?q=how do plants make food: zero 'No content is witnessed' errors on the page

items.title: Internal shape names are not user-facing
items.check: No text 'search methods complete'; no facet labels band_facts / what_is / fallback / walk

items.title: Packaging metadata and invented relations are not shown as knowledge
items.check: photosynthesis results + detail contain none of: 'type of pointer that lemma', 'upos:', 'HAS SENSE', 'variety of language:'

items.title: A natural-language question returns content
items.check: /explore?q=what is photosynthesis returns a row containing 'synthesis of compounds'

items.title: No raw long-precision numbers in Knowledge
items.check: No number with 8+ decimal places rendered on /explore or /explore?q=photosynthesis

items.title: At most two scroll containers on the search workspace
items.check: Count of scrollable elements inside main ≤ 2 on /explore?q=photosynthesis&selected=…

items.title: Chat answers a question the substrate knows
items.check: 'What is photosynthesis?' reply contains 'synthesis' within 45s; no 'no reply'

items.title: No debug dump inside the reply
items.check: Reply bubble contains no lifecycle table and no 'Forward pass proof' block

items.title: Failures show a plain message and Retry
items.check: With the stream aborted, reply shows a Retry button and no 'Exception'

items.title: Hash/mantissa is not a peer geometry view
items.check: /unicode has no 'Hash / mantissa' toggle; entity glome view has no 'Mantissa-unpacked' pane

items.title: Every claim shows its witness, source and standing
items.check: Expanding supporting claims on photosynthesis sense 1 shows a witness/source name and a standing value, not 'Recorded claim 1'

items.title: Highway layer counts do not contradict
items.check: /explore/highway/iso does not show both 'consensus edges across' (n>0) and 'No consensus edges witnessed'

items.title: Audit counts are labeled truthfully
items.check: /explore/audit contains no 'MEASURED): Not measured'

items.title: No invented HAS_*/IS_* relation names in UI
items.check: /explore/highway and /explore/highway/iso contain no /\b(HAS|IS)_[A-Z_]+/

items.title: Bank values are not graph nodes
items.check: Consensus graph read for 'dog' returns no node labeled NOUN/VERB/ADJ

items.title: 'Appears in' is first-class and ungated on every entity
items.check: /explore/entity/<dog> shows an 'Appears in' section with ≥1 sentence containing 'dog' without opening any disclosure; no 'Payment required'

items.title: Containment has total, paging and source per row
items.check: 'Appears in' shows a total count, a next-page control, and a source label on each row

items.title: The word is highlighted in each container
items.check: Each 'Appears in' row contains a <mark> around the word

items.title: Trajectory comparison exists
items.check: /explore/shape?x=dog&y=wolf renders a canvas and a Fréchet distance on realized curves

items.title: Graph has labeled edges, legend, filters, node panel
items.check: Entity graph shows a relation-type filter, a legend, and clicking a node opens a side panel naming the relation and witnesses

items.title: 2D graph shows labels; settings honored
items.check: 2D mode renders node labels; status hop count equals the hops setting

items.title: Constellation loads fast with readable labels
items.check: Loads in <10s; no label text contains '□' or a bare 32-hex id

items.title: Unicode glome can find a character and link to it
items.check: Search 'A' on /unicode selects U+0041 and offers a link to the entity

items.title: Sources catalogue loads
items.check: /explore/sources shows ≥1 source row and no 'catalog query failed'

items.title: Knowledge sub-navigation ≤ 5 items
items.check: Knowledge sections nav has ≤ 5 tabs

items.title: One search box per page
items.check: ≤ 1 visible searchbox on /explore, /chat, /explore/mesh

items.title: Entity page has one tab bar and no hidden inspector
items.check: /explore/entity/<dog> has exactly one tablist/nav of views and no <details> wrapping views

items.title: Entity page title is the label
items.check: Direct load of /explore/entity/<dog> has an h1/h2 'dog', not the hex id

items.title: One breadcrumb
items.check: ≤ 1 breadcrumb nav on /explore/mesh/<dog> and /chess/players/<name>

items.title: Mesh honors ?q=
items.check: /explore/mesh?q=dog shows the dog subject

items.title: Related information grouped by relation
items.check: Entity Knowledge view groups related facts under relation headings

items.title: Whitespace nodes are visible
items.check: Storage proof walk shows a visible glyph for space nodes

items.title: Forward trace form has no empty card
items.check: Before running, no empty panel taller than 200px

items.title: Move list in SAN
items.check: After e4 on /play the move list shows 'e4', not 'e2e4'

items.title: Board coordinates shown
items.check: Board renders file letters a–h

items.title: Player profile is formatted
items.check: Player page has no 10-digit Unix timestamps and no api.chess.com URLs as values

items.title: Substrate move scores are truthful
items.check: If every move is '±0 prior', the panel says the substrate has no evidence for this position

items.title: Calibration can be selected

items.title: Owner/platform admin can change Lichess routing
items.check: Lab › Lichess routing controls are enabled for a platform administrator

items.title: Admission history is listed
items.check: /data lists previously admitted artifacts for the workspace

items.title: Ingestion failures explain themselves
items.check: A failed run's error shows stage, file and a log excerpt, not only 'exited with status'

items.title: No Terminate on idle/self backends
items.check: System activity rows with state idle or the app's own backend have no Terminate button

items.title: VACUUM is not the primary action and needs confirmation
items.check: Run VACUUM button is not primary-styled; clicking opens a confirmation

items.title: Workspace directory is complete
items.check: Every workspace shows a non-empty ID; no duplicate rows

items.title: Operator copy is guidance, not commit messages
items.check: /operator?section=repair contains no 'incident' date references

items.title: Settings tab bar renders correctly
items.check: Active settings tab height ≤ 48px

items.title: Billing uses human labels
items.check: No dotted service ids (e.g. 'chat.completions') or raw tenant ids visible on /billing

items.title: Ambient familiar never covers content
items.check: Familiar is off by default or confined to a non-content gutter

items.title: One error/empty-state component
items.check: Error states render via [data-state=error] with request id inside a disclosure
